official_site_checks: The official paginated tag API reported 40 pages and 4,728 total entries. The bundled tag filter contains 807 entries with at least ten galleries; the freeform Tag field routes other names through the official tag search operator. The official language directory returns 14 classifications on one page. Popular artist, group, parody and character endpoints returned 120 correctly typed entries each on page 1 (277, 211, 37 and 149 pages respectively). The official search endpoint accepted artist:"ankoman" with 25 entries on its first page; the first result's detail API confirmed the matching artist tag. Source requests are paced at one per second to reduce rate-limit errors. Four sort page-1/2 probes passed in the prior live run; Home hit HTTP 429, so the complete live suite and device runtime remain unverified. Versions 18-23 add CDN requests, popular tag listings, chapter metadata and Aidoku multilingual language-filter support. A current request to /api/v2/tags/tag?sort=popular&page=1&per_page=100 returned HTTP 200 with 120 entries across 40 pages. Version 24 uses the official /api/v2/tags/tag/<slug> response to resolve tag deep links to the existing name-based Popular listing; a live lookup for big-breasts returned the canonical tag name, slug and path. Fixtures verify mapping and reject mismatched API identity, type and path. Aidoku runtime and device rendering remain unverified.
